WITH filtered_awards AS (
  SELECT 
    ma.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
    AND p.death_country != ''
  GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country
),
country_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    SUM(award_count) as total_awards
  FROM filtered_awards
  GROUP BY death_country
)
SELECT 
  fa.player_id as manager_id,
  fa.death_country,
  fa.award_count,
  CAST(fa.award_count AS FLOAT) / ct.total_awards as share
FROM filtered_awards fa
JOIN country_totals ct ON fa.death_country = ct.death_country
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULLS LAST syntax is supported in the ORDER BY clause (SQL:2003 standard; available in PostgreSQL, MySQL 8.0+, SQL Server, Oracle, but not SQLite)
